import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.FourierBody
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.FourierBase
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Hadamard
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Gradient
import QleisliKernel.Hierarchical.Conditional
open QleisliKernel.Hierarchical Artifact
set_option maxRecDepth 10000
def changed (a : Artifact) (index : Nat) (f : Definition → Definition) : Artifact :=
  {a with definitions := a.definitions.modify index f}
def renamedSide (s : Side) : Side :=
  {s with quantum := s.quantum.map fun p => {p with owner := 10000+p.owner, axes := p.axes.map (fun axis => 99999-7*axis)}}
def renamed (a : Artifact) : Artifact :=
  {a with definitions := a.definitions.map fun d => {d with
    interface := ⟨renamedSide d.interface.inputs,renamedSide d.interface.outputs⟩,
    body := match d.body with
      | .dyadicPhase owner j k => .dyadicPhase (10000+owner) j k
      | other => other}}
def status (a : Artifact) (precision width index remaining : Nat) : String :=
  match Gradient.inspect a precision width index remaining with
  | .ok p => s!"ok:{p.visits}"
  | .error .limit => "limit"
  | .error .invalidIr => "invalid_ir"
  | .error .contract => "contract"
def report (name : String) (a : Artifact) (precision width index remaining : Nat) : IO Unit :=
  IO.println s!"{name}|{status a precision width index remaining}"
def baseline (precision : Nat) (a : Artifact) (indices : Array Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let pending ← match Conditional.checkAll a (Array.range (totalNodes a)) with
    | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"whole typing {precision}: {repr e}"
    | .ok pending => pure pending
  let mut used := pending.state.visits
  for width in [:indices.size] do
    let index := indices[width]!
    let remaining := 2000000-used
    let p ← match Gradient.inspect a precision width index remaining with
      | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"inspect {precision}/{width}: {repr e}"
      | .ok p => pure p
    IO.println s!"accepted-{precision}-{width}|ok:{p.visits}"
    report s!"renamed-{precision}-{width}" (renamed a) precision width index remaining
    report s!"exact-{precision}-{width}" a precision width index p.visits
    report s!"short-{precision}-{width}" a precision width index (p.visits-1)
    used := used + p.visits
  IO.println s!"budget-{precision}|{pending.state.visits}|{used}"

def baseStatus (a : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : String :=
  match FourierBase.inspect a index remaining with
  | .ok p => s!"pending:{p.visits}"
  | .error .limit => "limit"
  | .error _ => "contract"
def hStatus (a : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : String :=
  match Hadamard.inspect a index remaining with
  | .ok p => s!"pending:{p.visits}"
  | .error .limit => "limit"
  | .error _ => "contract"
def baseReport (name : String) (a : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : IO Unit :=
  IO.println s!"{name}|{baseStatus a index remaining}"
def hReport (name : String) (a : Artifact) (index remaining : Nat) : IO Unit :=
  IO.println s!"{name}|{hStatus a index remaining}"
def emitH (name : String) (precision : Nat) (a : Artifact) (index : Nat) (expected : String) : IO Unit := do
  let p ← match Hadamard.inspect a index 2000000 with
    | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"request {name}: {repr e}"
    | .ok p => pure p
  let r := p.request
  let some input := r.leaf.interface.inputs.quantum[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "missing input"
  let some output := r.leaf.interface.outputs.quantum[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "missing output"
  let bytes := String.intercalate "," (r.program.data.toList.map (fun b => toString b.toNat))
  IO.println s!"LEAF|{name}|{precision}|{r.leafIndex}|{input.owner}|{output.owner}|{input.axes[0]!}|{output.axes[0]!}|{expected}|{bytes}"
def fullBaseline (precision : Nat) (a : Artifact) (gradients stages hs : Array Nat) (base : Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let checked ← match Conditional.checkAll a (Array.range (totalNodes a)) with
    | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"typing {precision}: {repr e}"
    | .ok p => pure p
  let mut used := checked.state.visits
  for width in [:gradients.size] do
    let p ← match Gradient.inspect a precision width gradients[width]! (2000000-used) with
      | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"gradient {precision}/{width}: {repr e}"
      | .ok p => pure p
    used := used+p.visits
  for offset in [:stages.size] do
    let p ← match FourierStage.inspect a (offset+1) stages[offset]! (2000000-used) with
      | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"stage {precision}/{offset}: {repr e}"
      | .ok p => pure p
    used := used+p.visits
  let before := used
  let b ← match FourierBase.inspect a base (2000000-used) with
    | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"base {precision}: {repr e}"
    | .ok p => pure p
  baseReport s!"base-{precision}" a base (2000000-used)
  baseReport s!"base-renamed-{precision}" (renamed a) base (2000000-used)
  baseReport s!"base-exact-{precision}" a base b.visits
  baseReport s!"base-short-{precision}" a base (b.visits-1)
  used := used+b.visits
  for offset in [:hs.size] do
    let index := hs[offset]!
    let p ← match Hadamard.inspect a index (2000000-used) with
      | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"H {precision}/{offset}: {repr e}"
      | .ok p => pure p
    hReport s!"h-{precision}-{offset}" a index (2000000-used)
    hReport s!"h-renamed-{precision}-{offset}" (renamed a) index (2000000-used)
    hReport s!"h-exact-{precision}-{offset}" a index p.visits
    hReport s!"h-short-{precision}-{offset}" a index (p.visits-1)
    emitH s!"h-{precision}-{offset}" precision a index "ok"
    used := used+p.visits
  IO.println s!"budget-{precision}|{checked.state.visits}|{before}|{used}"

def bodyStatus (a : Artifact) (precision width index remaining : Nat) : String :=
  match FourierBody.inspect a precision width index remaining with
  | .ok p => s!"pending:{p.visits}:{p.requests.length}"
  | .error .limit => "limit"
  | .error _ => "contract"
def bodyReport (name : String) (a : Artifact) (precision width index remaining : Nat) : IO Unit :=
  IO.println s!"{name}|{bodyStatus a precision width index remaining}"
def emitRequest (name : String) (precision : Nat) (r : Hadamard.Request) : IO Unit := do
  let some input := r.leaf.interface.inputs.quantum[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "missing input"
  let some output := r.leaf.interface.outputs.quantum[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "missing output"
  let bytes := String.intercalate "," (r.program.data.toList.map (fun b => toString b.toNat))
  IO.println s!"LEAF|{name}|{precision}|{r.leafIndex}|{input.owner}|{output.owner}|{input.axes[0]!}|{output.axes[0]!}|ok|{bytes}"
def bodyBaseline (precision : Nat) (a : Artifact) (indices : Array Nat) : IO Unit := do
  let checked ← match Conditional.checkAll a (Array.range (totalNodes a)) with
    | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"typing {precision}: {repr e}"
    | .ok p => pure p
  for offset in [:indices.size] do
    let width := offset+1
    let index := indices[offset]!
    let remaining := 2000000-checked.state.visits
    let p ← match FourierBody.inspect a precision width index remaining with
      | .error e => throw <| IO.userError s!"body {precision}/{width}: {repr e}"
      | .ok p => pure p
    bodyReport s!"body-{precision}-{width}" a precision width index remaining
    bodyReport s!"renamed-{precision}-{width}" (renamed a) precision width index remaining
    bodyReport s!"exact-{precision}-{width}" a precision width index p.visits
    bodyReport s!"short-{precision}-{width}" a precision width index (p.visits-1)
    if width = precision then
      IO.println s!"budget-{precision}|{checked.state.visits}|{checked.state.visits+p.visits}"
      for (request, i) in p.requests.zipIdx do
        emitRequest s!"h-{precision}-{i}" precision request

def main : IO Unit := do
  bodyBaseline 1 qft1 #[10]
  bodyBaseline 2 qft2 #[22,24]
  bodyBaseline 3 qft3 #[35,37,39]
  bodyBaseline 4 qft4 #[48,50,52,54]
  bodyBaseline 5 qft5 #[61,63,65,67,69]
  bodyBaseline 6 qft6 #[74,76,78,80,82,84]
  bodyBaseline 7 qft7 #[87,89,91,93,95,97,99]
  bodyBaseline 8 qft8 #[100,102,104,106,108,110,112,114]
  bodyReport "negative-control" (changed qft8 44 (fun d => {d with body := .control 43 false})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "wrong-repeat" (changed qft8 51 (fun d => {d with body := .repeatOp 3 41})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "zero-repeat" (changed qft8 51 (fun d => {d with body := .repeatOp 0 41})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "omitted-repeat" (changed qft8 52 (fun d => {d with body := .control 41 true})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "wrong-gradient" (changed qft8 44 (fun d => {d with body := .control 41 true})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "phase-numerator" (changed qft8 10 (fun d => {d with body := .dyadicPhase 106 2 2})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "phase-exponent" (changed qft8 10 (fun d => {d with body := .dyadicPhase 106 1 3})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "phase-owner" (changed qft8 10 (fun d => {d with body := .dyadicPhase 909090 1 2})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "recursive-cycle" (changed qft8 113 (fun d => {d with body := .tensor 45 114})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "stage-order" (changed qft8 114 (fun d => {d with body := .sequence #[1,113,44,7,2]})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "base-body" (changed qft8 100 (fun d => {d with body := .repeatOp 1 100})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "h-missing-leaf" (changed qft8 5 (fun d => {d with body := .sequence #[]})) 8 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "missing-root" qft8 8 8 999999 2000000
  bodyReport "wrong-precision" qft8 7 7 112 2000000
  bodyReport "zero-width" qft8 8 0 114 2000000
  bodyReport "oversized-profile" qft8 9 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "width-over-precision" qft8 7 8 114 2000000
  bodyReport "zero-budget" qft8 8 8 114 0
  bodyReport "reset-budget" qft8 8 8 114 2000001
  bodyReport "opaque-h-pending" (changed qft8 3 (fun d => {d with body := .leaf ByteArray.empty})) 8 8 114 2000000
  emitH "wrong-x" 8 (changed qft8 3 (fun d => {d with body := .leaf ("{\"evidence\":[],\"format\":\"qleisli.finite-ir\",\"profile\":\"finite-meaning-v1\",\"programs\":[{\"classical_inputs\":[],\"classical_outputs\":[],\"declared_effect\":\"unitary\",\"operations\":[{\"gate\":\"x\",\"input\":107,\"output\":5,\"tag\":\"gate\"}],\"quantum_inputs\":[{\"shape\":{\"bits\":1},\"token\":107,\"wires\":[7]}],\"quantum_outputs\":[5]}],\"root\":0,\"root_interface\":{\"input\":{\"tag\":\"bit\"},\"output\":{\"tag\":\"bit\"}},\"sources\":[],\"version\":2}").toUTF8})) 5 "contract"
  emitH "negative-h" 8 (changed qft8 3 (fun d => {d with body := .leaf ("{\"evidence\":[],\"format\":\"qleisli.finite-ir\",\"profile\":\"finite-meaning-v1\",\"programs\":[{\"classical_inputs\":[],\"classical_outputs\":[],\"declared_effect\":\"unitary\",\"operations\":[{\"gate\":\"h\",\"input\":107,\"output\":1000,\"tag\":\"gate\"},{\"gate\":\"x\",\"input\":1000,\"output\":1001,\"tag\":\"gate\"},{\"gate\":\"z\",\"input\":1001,\"output\":1002,\"tag\":\"gate\"},{\"gate\":\"x\",\"input\":1002,\"output\":1003,\"tag\":\"gate\"},{\"gate\":\"z\",\"input\":1003,\"output\":5,\"tag\":\"gate\"}],\"quantum_inputs\":[{\"shape\":{\"bits\":1},\"token\":107,\"wires\":[7]}],\"quantum_outputs\":[5]}],\"root\":0,\"root_interface\":{\"input\":{\"tag\":\"bit\"},\"output\":{\"tag\":\"bit\"}},\"sources\":[],\"version\":2}").toUTF8})) 5 "contract"
  emitH "empty-h" 8 (changed qft8 3 (fun d => {d with body := .leaf ("").toUTF8})) 5 "format"
  emitH "stale-renamed-h" 8 (renamed qft8) 5 "contract"
